findings.current: Smuggling and refining Magic Gems illegally were grave crimes explicitly covered by international law, but there were plenty of loopholes.
findings.defect: The draft makes refining the crime; the source names leaving the gems unrefined.
findings.rationale: 미정제 means non-refinement, not illegal refinement.
findings.replacement: Smuggling in Magic Gems and leaving them unrefined were grave crimes explicitly covered by international law, but there were plenty of loopholes.
findings.source: 마정석의 밀반입 및 미정제는 국제법에도 명시된 엄청난 중죄지만, 빈틈은 얼마든지 있다.

findings.current: And the day that bomb went off, it was easy enough to imagine the Great Cataclysm beginning, just as the Main Quest I’d been given was titled.
findings.defect: The draft substitutes Great Cataclysm for the Main Quest’s title, Cataclysm.
findings.rationale: The source says 격변, while 대격변 is the distinct term rendered Great Cataclysm.
findings.replacement: And the day that bomb went off, it was easy enough to imagine the Cataclysm beginning, just as the Main Quest I’d been given was titled.
findings.source: 그리고 그 폭탄이 터지는 날. 내게 주어진 메인 퀘스트의 제목처럼 격변(激變)이 시작되리라는 것쯤은 어렵지 않게 예상할 수 있었다.

findings.current: *That cunning human once said the only good Chinese was a dead Chinese, but it seems there are exceptions, even if they’re few and far between.*
findings.defect: Chinese neutralizes the ethnic slur the Skeleton King recalls.
findings.rationale: 짱깨 is derogatory; the source’s offensive register is part of the recalled remark.
findings.replacement: *That devious human once said the only good Chink was a dead Chink, but it seems there are exceptions, even if they’re few and far between.*
findings.source: ‘간악한 인간의 말에 의하면 착한 짱깨는 죽은 짱깨뿐이라고 했는데, 역시 극소수지만 예외는 있군.’

findings.current: He’d also had his eye on several Middle Eastern countries that had sided with Michael Silbert at the recent UN General Assembly.
findings.defect: Had his eye on loses Furin’s hostile intent to retaliate.
findings.rationale: 벼르고 있었다 conveys a grudge and an intention to act, which explains the force of Russia’s warning.
findings.replacement: He’d also been itching to settle the score with several Middle Eastern countries that had sided with Michael Silbert at the recent UN General Assembly.
findings.source: 얼마 전 열렸던 UN 총회 당시 미카엘 실베르트의 편에 섰던 몇몇 중동 국가를 벼르고 있었다.

findings.current: *Of course, half the Magic Gems they acquire that way are probably smuggled out the back door.*
findings.defect: Smuggled out specifies a method or destination; the source only says the gems are illicitly siphoned off.
findings.rationale: 뒷구멍으로 빠져나가다 describes diversion without establishing that the gems leave the region.
findings.replacement: *Of course, half the Magic Gems obtained that way probably disappear through back channels.*
findings.source: ‘물론, 그렇게 습득한 마정석 중 절반은 뒷구멍으로 빠져나가겠지만.’

findings.current: Or maybe it was because of three words that had never left my mind.
findings.defect: The draft turns the source’s three Korean syllabic characters into three words.
findings.rationale: 세 글자 refers to the three syllables of 선지자, a single word.
findings.replacement: Or maybe it was because of those three syllables that had never left my mind.
findings.source: 아니, 어쩌면 줄곧 뇌리를 떠나지 않는 세 글자 때문일지도.

findings.current: The worst terrorist in history, far beyond the South American drug lords—or even Osama bin Laden, who’d been at it long before them.
findings.defect: Them makes bin Laden a predecessor of the drug lords rather than of The Prophet.
findings.rationale: 한참 선배 격인 compares bin Laden’s seniority to the terrorist under discussion.
findings.replacement: The worst terrorist in history, far beyond the South American drug lords or even his much older predecessor, Osama bin Laden.
findings.source: 남미의 마약왕이나, 한참 선배 격인 오사마 빈 라덴을 아득히 뛰어넘은 사상 최악의 테러리스트.

summary: The draft has one reversed legal detail and several localized losses of meaning, register, or specificity.
